breakdown.description: Both RAS and LES models are defined in `turbulenceProperties`. An OpenFOAM simulation cannot be both RAS and LES simultaneously; one must be chosen.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'Use RANS turbulence modeling with the kEpsilon model' and 'The constant/turbulenceProperties file should contain only the RAS block... No LES block should be present.' This correctly resolves the inconsistency by removing the LES block and using only RAS, matching the ground truth.
